parsed.why: Decriminalised 2021 with anti-discrimination statute, but no gender-marker route, no entry provisions recorded, single documented police attack on a trans woman, and significant social pressure; thin enforcement data. Elevated band, leaning low.

Self-declaration gender recognition, marriage equality, employer duties and a court upholding a trans student's rights; hate-crime rising and no national hate-crime statute, but no traveller-facing restriction documented and state detention law respects gender identity. Low to reduced risk boundary.

Criminalised sodomy with increased penalties after 2022, state torture of suspects, psychiatric confinement, vigilante violence with impunity, and no anti-discrimination law; state-directed enforcement and documented torture push to near-severe.

Gender expression itself criminalised with documented arrests and multi-year sentences for cross-dressing, border strip-search of a genderqueer visitor, digital-evidence surveillance, and deportation for convictions. Severe, though no custody placement data and no recent case after 2020.

Anti-discrimination and hate-crime law covers gender identity and the armed forces are open, but medicalised recognition, a state-tolerated lethal attack on an LGBT bar, official homophobic statements, and a hostile climate with no partner recognition. High-risk band.
